title: The Qualifications of a Rewriter
next_chapter_hook: What ultimate scheme lies hidden behind Cang Yutian's bargain? What Chen Ji is about to face is a mastermind more terrifying than Heavenly Will itself.

text.content: Deep within the Mental Sea, golden light curtains pressed down like a tide, Cang Yutian's will weighing over Chen Ji like a mountain range. The pressure was so immense it threatened to crush his divine soul, the air thick with suffocating oppression. Yet Chen Ji slowly straightened his spine, a hint of nonchalance curving his lips. His voice echoed through the Mental Sea, clear and resolute: 'You say I'm a piece?' He paused, then chuckled softly, 'Then today, let me show you what it means to be the Chess Player.'

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling golden radiance! The light shattered the Mental Sea's confines, piercing straight toward the heavens, forcibly tearing apart Cang Yutian's golden light curtain! Chen Ji felt an unprecedented force surge from the fragment, racing along his meridians and flooding into every limb. That was the power of fate's inscription—the fragment responded to his call with such completeness for the first time.

dialogue.content: 'My fate is mine to control, not heaven's!' Chen Ji's voice thundered like an explosion, echoing throughout the Mental Sea and even into the real world. The Tianji Record's light reached its peak with his words, blindingly brilliant beyond直视. The primordial inscribed patterns疯狂流转, as if witnessing a moment of fate's rewriting.

text.content: The golden light curtain began to collapse under the light's assault, shattering like broken mirrors. Cang Yutian's illusory form wavered for the first time, and on that eternally transcendent face actually appeared a trace of—surprise? Chen Ji saw it! Clearly saw it! That face of Heavenly Will that had existed for ten thousand years was now moved because of him!

dialogue.content: '...Interesting.' Cang Yutian's voice remained majestic, but carried an unprecedented appreciation, 'For ten thousand years, ten thousand years—never once has a piece dared speak such words to me. You are the first.' The illusory form slowly raised its hand, the golden light curtain completely dissipating, 'Chen Ji, you have proven your qualification to me—the qualification of a Chess Player.'

text.content: The Tianji Record's light began to slowly收敛, but the trajectory it illuminated had already been deeply carved into the memory of every presence present. The celestial native forces were forced to retreat before that light, none daring to直视那轮烈日般的辉煌. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his black hair floating in the remnant light, his figure already entirely different in everyone's eyes.

dialogue.content: 'You are the only existence in ten thousand years to surprise me.' Cang Yutian's voice echoed through the void, carrying a posture of dialogue approaching equality, 'Since you have proven your qualification, I shall give you an opportunity—a real bargain.' His illusory form grew increasingly faint, but his tone became increasingly grave, 'I will teach you the complete method of 'Destiny Writing.'

text.content: Teach the complete method of Destiny Writing? Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, his vigilance rising to its highest. When had Heavenly Will become so easy to talk to? Unexpected kindness must hide ill intent. His fingers gently stroked the Tianji Record's cover, feeling the warm fluctuations emanating from within. It was a complex emotion—anticipation mixed with deep wariness.

dialogue.content: 'The condition is simple.' Cang Yutian's illusory form had become almost transparent, but his voice remained clear, 'I want you to search for a soul imprint. It is a relic from ancient times—if you can bring it before me...' Before he finished speaking, the Tianji Record suddenly shuddered, the characters on the fragment beginning to twist violently, as if issuing some kind of warning!

text.content: A flash of sharp light appeared in Chen Ji's eyes. He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record; the twisted characters gradually calmed, but left a clear warning—a dangerous trap. His lips slowly curved, and he looked toward the dissipating illusory form, his voice cold and clear as ice: 'Cang Yutian, do you take me for a three-year-old child?'

dialogue.content: 'A soul imprint, an ancient relic, help you search—this condition sounds very simple.' Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of mockery, 'But why don't you search for it yourself? With the might of your Heavenly Eye, finding an imprint would be effortless. The only explanation is—the location of that imprint is a place you cannot reach.' He paused, 'Or, the imprint itself is an existence you dare not touch.'

text.content: Cang Yutian's illusory form completely dissipated, leaving only an echoing laughter: 'Chen Ji, you are indeed more interesting than I imagined. Until we meet again.' The laughter faded into the distance, but the deeper meaning in those words coiled around his heart like a venomous snake. The Tianji Record's warmth gradually settled, and Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in the Mental Sea, carrying a hint of relief: 'Well done, boy. But this is far from over...'

Chen Ji stood quietly in place, the Tianji Record in his hand returning to its usual temperature. He looked up at the heavens; the rift there had long since healed, as if nothing had ever happened. But Chen Ji knew that from this day forward, everything was different. He had used the power of Destiny Writing to forcibly rewrite the ending Cang Yutian had preset, he had proven to Heaven that he was not a piece, but the true Chess Player. But this also meant he had completely stood on the opposite side of Heaven.

choice.prompt: What secrets lie hidden behind Cang Yutian's bargain?

choices.text: Tracing the Truth of the Soul Imprint
choices.description: Since Heavenly Will wants that imprint, it must be extraordinary and worth exploring despite the risk.
choices.risk_hint: What kind of existence would Heavenly Will not dare to touch?

text.content: The Tianji Record grew slightly warm, as if responding to his decision. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: 'Since you have decided, be careful. That imprint is related to the ancient prophet... Perhaps, it is precisely the key to unlocking the Tianji Record's true secrets.'

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng seems to know many secrets; perhaps I can get answers from him.
choices.visible_cost: Mo Xiansheng May Not Tell Everything
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng always only says what he should say.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, the fluctuations in his remnant soul revealing a trace of hesitation: 'That imprint... is the remnant of the first ancient prophet.' His voice grew low, 'Heavenly Will wants to destroy it because it is the only existence capable of threatening Heavenly Will.'

choices.text: Searching for Clues of Other Prophets
choices.description: Since I am the only existence in ten thousand years to surprise Heavenly Will, perhaps I should search for the footsteps of predecessors.
choices.risk_hint: The fates of ancient prophets were not good.

text.content: On the Tianji Record's cover, a blurry map actually slowly emerged. That was a secret even Mo Xiansheng did not know—a hidden route marking the ancient prophet's ruins. Chen Ji's heart stirred; perhaps predecessors' experiences could give him more inspiration.

However, no matter which path is chosen, one thing is certain—Chen Ji is no longer that hidden废物disciple who could lurk in the shadows. Since Heaven's Eye has noticed him, every step ahead will be like walking on thin ice. But he does not regret. Today, in front of Heaven's Eye, he declared 'My fate is mine to control, not heaven's,' he used the power of Destiny Writing to forcibly rewrite the predetermined ending, he proved—he is not a piece, but the true Chess Player.

Although the Tianji Record's light has收敛, the traces left by that golden radiance have been deeply carved into history. This moment, Chen Ji's name will be recorded by Heaven—not as a piece, but as an opponent. And this is merely the beginning. Cang Yutian's bargain conditions remain unsettled, the shadow of Heaven's Eye has not yet dissipated, and a greater chess game is slowly unfolding. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, his gaze resolute. He knows the true game has just begun.
